correctness.rationale: For unweighted C_n all-shortest-path convex proper subsets are precisely cyclic arcs of edge length at most L=floor((n-1)/2), plus empty and full. Every two-point support is shattered; three-point trace patterns require and suffice that all three successive gaps be <=L, and summing 4 triple-exclusion inequalities excludes any shattered four-point set. Cyclic composition counting gives T_n=n(n^2-1)/24 for odd n, n(n-2)(n-4)/24 even, with n=4 exception. Fixed-origin short arcs parameterized by independent left/right thresholds produce the complete online depth lower bound; concept count supplies upper, giving Ldim=2log2 n+O(1). Independently brute-enumerated convex sets via all shortest paths for small n, validating exact triple counts; proof covers all n, and exact finite n online dimensions are not claimed.
